reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because the hosts investigate a cryptocurrency mining offer, point out inconsistencies in its website and contract, and warn viewers that its promised returns are unrealistic. The discussed mining site asks viewers to choose and purchase a miner, but the hosts present that as the third-party offer under scrutiny, not as their own solicitation; the description's separate trading-service promotion does not establish a deceptive claim or money flow.

opening.argument: The offer ties a direct purchase to recurring mining income. Viewers are told to choose a miner, examine its profitability and payback period, contact the operator on Instagram to purchase it, and then receive installation with profit tracking after payment. That is not merely discussion of cryptocurrency: it is a concrete purchase pathway paired with promised earnings. The arrangement also describes a 40/60 profit share, while the contract language is presented as guaranteeing the return throughout the miner's operating term. Taken together, the requested purchase and the promised mining returns establish the relevant solicitation.

after purchasing the miner will be installed on our farm within 24 hours and you'll be able to track your profit in your account on the website
the return indicated on the website shall be guaranteed and unchanged throughout the miners operation operating term

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the offer third-party does not remove the offer's actual purchase-and-return structure from the video. The hosts themselves read the instructions linking purchase to installation and profit tracking, then discuss the guarantee and operating term. Whether the hosts endorse it is separate from whether the material presents a paid mining package connected to income. The description's separate promotion is not needed to establish that relationship.

citations.quote: after purchasing the miner will be installed on our farm within 24 hours and you'll be able to track your profit in your account on the website
the return indicated on the website shall be guaranteed and unchanged throughout the miners operation operating term

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The purchase pathway is quoted as evidence under examination, not as a solicitation by the hosts. Their stated purpose is educational analysis, and they repeatedly characterize the claims as suspicious rather than promising viewers these returns. The quoted contract language therefore shows what the investigated website claimed, while the video presents no host-side offer to sell miners or collect payment.

opening.argument: The offer concentrates multiple risk signals around paid mining: a stated profit share, a guaranteed unchanged return, a four-year operating term, installation within 24 hours of payment, and specific daily and monthly returns. The site also permits payment in Bitcoin or PayPal and advertises unlimited profit withdrawals. These are not isolated cryptocurrency references; they form a package of easy, fixed-looking income attached to buying mining equipment. The product page visibly pairs mining equipment with prices, BUY NOW controls, and daily and monthly returns. The combination gives viewers a reason to pay while minimizing the appearance of uncertainty normally associated with mining.

citations.quote: We share the profit in the ratio of 40% us, 60 to our clients
the return indicated on the website shall be guaranteed and unchanged throughout the miners operation operating term
installation of minor shall be performed within 24 hours from the moment of the user's payments of the miners cost
return per day, $142 return per month, 4,260

rebuttal.rebuttal: The warning framing does not neutralize the signals placed before viewers. The reference account concedes that the site asks users to purchase miners and describes guaranteed returns; those are precisely the risk indicators, not harmless background. The hosts' skepticism may affect credibility, but it does not change that the displayed offer combines purchase buttons, equipment prices, and recurring return figures.

citations.quote: after purchasing the miner will be installed on our farm within 24 hours and you'll be able to track your profit in your account on the website
the return indicated on the website shall be guaranteed and unchanged throughout the miners operation operating term

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These signals are presented as red flags in an investigation, not as assurances to viewers. The hosts explicitly say the episode is meant to educate people by breaking down the math, and they question whether the promised operation even exists. A product page and quoted claims can establish what the investigated site displayed, but they do not establish that this video deceptively offers those returns.

opening.argument: The apparent investigation also functions as promotional content for an alternative financial pathway. The description urges viewers to join Trick Trades for a path to financial freedom and directs them to a free webinar about a “game-changing” trading app. In the video, the host contrasts the mining offer with opening a day-trading account and says that following the program's direction can produce income. Separately, the displayed mining site's referral page visibly organizes Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum statuses around inviting friends or making an investment. This combination of financial-freedom messaging and tiered participation makes the content promotional in effect, even while it is framed as criticism.

Be sure to check out the Free Webinar to learn more about our game-changing Size UP! App
You could have taken $9,000 of it and opened up a proper day trading account
all you need to do is just fully listen to what we're directing you to do, and it will happen

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference side treats the separate promotion as irrelevant, but the description explicitly places a freedom-oriented join request and trading-app webinar alongside the investigation. The video also recommends a paid alternative and says following its direction will produce results. Meanwhile, the mining website's referral page visibly uses investment and invitations to organize tiers. That is more than neutral reporting of an ordinary product.

citations.quote: Join Trick Trades and get your Freedom here
You could have taken $9,000 of it and opened up a proper day trading account

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The description's separate calls to join a webinar or service do not prove that the mining investigation is a recruitment scheme, and the hosts expressly reject the investigated offer's easy-money premise. The referral tiers are shown as part of the third-party site's evidence, not as a tier system for viewers of this video. Criticizing one financial offer while mentioning another does not establish deceptive recruitment.
